name: Arrow Energy 'Go Further' Indigenous Tertiary Scholarship (UQ)
provider: University of Queensland and Arrow Energy
summary: One-year scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ coursework students facing financial hardship.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled in any coursework program in the semester of the award.
how: Apply using the online application form. One application covers several UQ scholarship schemes.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.
